name: Hidden Christian Sites in the Nagasaki Region
description: On the north-western edge of Kyushu, in Nagasaki and Kumamoto prefectures, twelve sites trace the story of Japan's "hidden Christians." For over two centuries, while the faith was banned, villagers kept it alive in secret. You can visit fishing and farming hamlets, the ruins of Hara Castle, and a cathedral built after the ban was lifted in 1873.
